title: US Net Liquidity
description: Weekly Fed assets minus TGA minus overnight RRP, trillions of dollars.
summary: Net liquidity is the Fed's balance sheet minus cash the Treasury is holding minus cash parked overnight at the Fed. What is left is the cash sloshing in markets. This series only starts in December 2002, when the Fed published these pieces together. It is not a 1980s chart. The overnight RRP pile was tiny until 2021, then huge, then drained.
